title: Song And Dance
paragraphs: “How do you feel about Filo getting married?”
“Filo-tan’s partner is her fiancé and me. I won’t allow anyone else, even if they’re a Filolial!”
“I’m getting more and more confused!”
“Ahaha…”
Father gave us a wry smile as he watched.

“For now, let’s put the matchmaking talks on hold. Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan may seem special now. But since Filolials raised by heroes tend to grow in unique ways, their value will relatively decrease over time.”
“Kou, now’s your chance to sing and dance at this ranch to charm them. Build your harem!”
“Lots of wives?”
“What are you making him do?!”
Itsuki keeps nagging at me. I don’t care. This is about Kou’s future.
But… if Filo-tan is among the Filolials here, that’s a different story. If it’s Filo-tan, then I won’t allow even Kou to touch her. Of course, I’ll try to get Kou to give up peacefully.
“So, what are you saying?”
“I think you understand, but we came here to buy Filolials… we want to increase our companions. In that process, if you wish, we can offer Filolials in return.”
“Oh!”
The rancher’s eyes sparkled. And he was looking at Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan.
“Well, regarding breeding and such, as long as it’s something they want, I won’t object.”
“Understood. I deal with rowdy Filolials every day. That’s my job, after all.”
“Father, that’s the wrong objective.”
The goal is to search for Filo-tan, which results in more Filolials. It’s not that searching for Filolials will lead us to Filo-tan. Father raised a finger.
Does he have an idea?
“Therefore, if possible, we’d like you to provide us with many Filolials… how about it?”
“Hmm…”
“Of course, for trust’s sake, you can accompany us during the training, and I have no problem with jointly registering them with the monster crest.”
“It’s too good of a deal. If I hadn’t seen it with my own eyes, I wouldn’t have believed it. I mean, there’s even a part of me that doubts whether they’re really Filolials.”

“Of course, we have some conditions as well. One of them is confirming whether they can become Queens or Kings. Motoyasu, if a hero registers them, they can evolve, even if they’re not chicks, right?”
“Yes, that’s correct!”

In the first world, Piyo-chan, who became part of Father’s party, was originally just an ordinary Filolial. From what I heard, Father had asked Filo-tan not to become a Queen. Without knowing that, I made it happen. Similarly, I’ve registered Filolials from other places as their master and caused them to become Kings and Queens multiple times.
“Yes, that’s right. It might be a good idea to test here whether a Filolial changes upon being registered with the monster crest. You have the equipment, right?”
“Yeah.”
The breeder brought some registration ink and led a Filolial from the coop.
“I’ll handle the registration this time.”
Father registered the Filolial with the monster crest in front of the breeder. This means the Filolial is now jointly owned with the breeder.
“Gu… gua…”

There’s already a slight change occurring in the registered Filolial. Even though it should already be fully grown, I can hear the sounds of further growth. By the way, in the first world, the attending physician determined that when a hero registers as the master, some kind of genetic seal is released. Even when Father was being consumed by the Cursed Shield, he mentioned something similar about the Filolials.
“It will take a little time for the mutation to finish, right?”
“Please keep a close eye on it and manage it carefully. It will take a bit more time to gain complete trust.”
“So? What do you plan to do in the meantime?”
“Trust isn’t fully established yet. But we still have several requests. We’ve brought money for that purpose.”
Father said this while showing a bag full of gold coins to the breeder.
“Money is important, isn’t it? It’s a form of trust that can’t be replaced. Until trust is fully built, it can serve as a temporary guarantee.”
“…Yeah.”

“I’d also like to use this money to request the provision of more Filolials. While we work on establishing trust, I’ll provide financial support. And once I judge that trust has been earned, I’ll ask for full cooperation.”
“…What exactly do you want me to do?”
Father gave the breeder a suggestive look. That kind of atmosphere is something Father excels at creating. He’s trying to extract information from the other party by making them sense something.
“Could it be… you’re after the rights to a famous racing Filolial for the Filolial races I’m aiming for?”
…That’s completely off.

But the Filolial races, huh? That’s a famous event in Zeltoble and is held in various other places as well. It’s apparently a fairly well-known form of gambling in this world. Horses are horses, but they lack flair and seem plain. Dragons, on the other hand, are costly due to stamina and feeding issues, and the restrictions on flying species make them a hassle. The same goes for griffins. In that regard, Filolials are highly popular because the results can vary greatly depending on how they are raised. This breeder is definitely interested in Filolial races. It’s also clear that he’s involved in raising combat Filolials as well. Father cast a suggestive glance toward the pasture outside.
“Don’t tell me… that too!? Are you planning to get involved in producing strong Filolials as well!?”
“If you’re going to eat poison, you might as well lick the plate clean… I think I can deliver results. Well, if you don’t trust me, I can always take this offer to another ranch.”
Father stood up as if he had no further interest.
“W-Wait! Give me… a little time to think!”

Father grinned. Later, he explained that it was all a bluff. He had a feeling that Filolial races might exist, but he never imagined that different breeding combinations could produce combat Filolials. The important thing is, dangling a tempting offer and then pulling it away at the last moment is the most effective way to shake the other party. As expected of Father. He waits until the opponent can’t refuse and then makes unreasonable demands.
“Alright then… I’ll need an answer by noon tomorrow. We’re busy too, I say.”
“Understood! I’ll give you an answer by then!”
Honestly, we could only watch the situation in stunned silence.
“Well then, I’d suggest keeping an eye on the changes in that Filolial by the hour until tomorrow.”
With that, we quickly left the ranch. The breeder saw us off with a terribly conflicted expression.
“So, with that said, we’ll prepare the ship tickets for Cal Mira Island by tomorrow noon.”
“Iwatani-dono, what was that negotiation just now? Judging by his reaction, was it not possible to seal the deal immediately?”
At Éclair’s question, Ren and Itsuki nodded.
Was there something strange about it? Father just did what he could do.
“It’s all part of negotiation tactics. You need to give the other party time to think, but you also have to make the disadvantages of refusing look much bigger.”
“I see.”
“Well, it sounds bad, but it’s about giving them time to understand our position, right? And honestly, it’s not a bad deal for them either.”
“What about Filo-tan!?”
That’s right!
How are we supposed to find Filo-tan!?

“Judging by what I’ve seen and what little we talked about, that rancher seems to be the boss around here. So whether it’s tracking down Sakura-chan’s relatives or finding a Filolial with the same color as Filo, we need to take some steps first.”
“Can’t we ask the monster merchant? Isn’t there something else we can do!?”
“Of course, we’ll do that as well. But if we make too big of a fuss about it, there’s a high chance we’ll end up getting scammed by someone looking to make a quick buck.”
Father calmly explained everything to me.
